title: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW will soon preserve grants, comments and tags by default
body:
Starting October 12, 2026, `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW` will update views in-place, instead of dropping and re-creating the view. Grants, tags, and comments are preserved with two caveats:

* As views execute with view owner's permissions, grants are not preserved if a non-owner alters the view query via `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW`
* You must first remove [governed tags](/aws/en/admin/governed-tags) on a view column before dropping the column via `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW`. Otherwise, the statement will fail with a `CANNOT_DROP_TAGGED_COLUMN` error.

Use `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW <catalog>.<schema>.<view> NOCOPY *` to drop grants, tags, and comments on the view explicitly (governed tags are still retained).

See [CREATE VIEW](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-ddl-create-view) and [Drop a column with governed tags](/aws/en/database-objects/tags#drop).
